title: A Pentagon Influencer Called Liberal Women a ‘Pestilence’ Who Will End Western Civilization
gist: Kurt Schlichter, a retired Army colonel and X influencer with 620,000+ followers who worked as a civilian Pentagon employee on Hegseth's anti-woke war-college task force, has a history of praising Pinochet and Franco, attacking liberal women and immigrants, and proposing property and military service qualifications for voting.

insights.claim: Kurt Schlichter, a retired Army colonel with over 620,000 X followers, was given a government email and confirmed working as a civilian employee on a Pentagon task force rooting out 'woke' ideologies at war colleges.
insights.speaker: David Gilbert
insights.so_what: Politicization of defense institutions signals governance and institutional risk.

insights.claim: Pentagon press secretary Kingsley Wilson said the department was proud to have Schlichter contribute to its Senior Service College Task Force.
insights.speaker: David Gilbert
insights.so_what: The Pentagon openly endorses the influencer program despite controversy.
insights.quote: Nothing is more important than the formation of our future military leaders

insights.claim: Hegseth's Defense Department required journalists to sign a pledge restricting information gathering, leading most major journalists to leave the Pentagon.
insights.speaker: David Gilbert
insights.so_what: Reduced press access lowers transparency on defense policy.
insights.locator: In an August 2021 thread on X

insights.claim: Schlichter has advocated disqualifying childless people from political participation and establishing property and military-service qualifications for voting.
insights.speaker: David Gilbert
insights.so_what: Anti-democratic views inside defense structures signal political-risk escalation.
insights.quote: Establish property and military service qualifications for voting.
insights.locator: In the same thread on X

insights.claim: Schlichter has praised dictators, writing that Pinochet 'was too soft' and that 'Franco did nothing wrong'.
insights.speaker: David Gilbert
insights.so_what: Normalization of authoritarian admiration in government-adjacent circles.
